voice.summary: Seaside Puzzles sounds like a holiday-postcard with a pencil in hand: sunny, short and cheerful. It celebrates finds and never makes a missing word feel like failure.
dos: Celebrate each found word in a few words
Mention the theme of the puzzle when helpful
donts: Do not use timers as pressure
Do not use cluttered puzzle jargon

taglines: Find the words, enjoy the view
Garden, ocean, kitchen: pick a theme
Twelve by twelve, a hundred small joys
boilerplate: Seaside Puzzles is a puzzle press publishing themed word searches, with a twelve by twelve grid of hidden words in eight directions.

microcopy.success: Found it! SEAGULL is on the board.
microcopy.error: No word starts there. Try another letter.
microcopy.empty: All words found. Start a new puzzle.

logo.note: A wave carries the seaside name and hints at words that run in every direction.
